name: Tim Cook
summary: Operations and supply-chain executive with deep experience in global manufacturing, logistics and services growth. Delivers reliably at scale while keeping teams focused on customers and privacy.

children: Leading Apple's strategic expansion into Services, Wearables, and emerging technology sectors.
Driving massive revenue growth and multi-trillion-dollar market capitalization through ecosystem integration.
Managing the global rollout of products like the Apple Watch, AirPods, and Apple Silicon.
Overseeing the diversification of Apple's business model from hardware-only to a services-centric powerhouse.
Leading Apple's commitment to becoming carbon neutral across its entire supply chain by 2030.
Implementing advanced environmental standards for material sourcing and manufacturing.
Championing privacy and security as a fundamental human right within the Apple ecosystem.
Transformed Apple's supply chain into a highly efficient, world-class operation.
Optimized inventory management and vendor relationships to minimize waste and maximize responsiveness.
Developed the logistics and manufacturing framework that enabled the massive scale of the iPod and iPhone era.

projects.title: Apple Services Revolution
projects.subtitle: Ecosystem Growth
bullets: Orchestrated the massive growth of Apple Services (iCloud, Apple Music, App Store, etc.).
Created a highly integrated and profitable ecosystem that drives recurring revenue.
Established Apple as a leader in the services-driven business model.

projects.title: Apple Silicon Transition
projects.subtitle: Hardware & Architecture
bullets: Overseeing the transition from Intel-based Mac computers to custom Apple Silicon (M-series chips).
Leading the development of high-performance, energy-efficient architecture for consumer electronics.
Driving vertical integration in hardware and software design.

activities.title: Global Supply Chain Advocacy
activities.subtitle: Industry Leadership
bullets: Promoting sustainable and ethical manufacturing practices globally.
Speaking on the importance of operational excellence in the modern era.
Advocating for technological accessibility and privacy.
